user.title: Totalplay STB local remote
user.description: Leave the IP blank to discover Totalplay decoders automatically. If you enter an IP, the integration verifies it with the same STB information endpoint used by discovery.

discovered.title: Select Totalplay decoder
discovered.description: More than one Totalplay decoder responded to the STB information probe.

display.title: Connected television
display.description: Select the TV or media player that displays this decoder's HDMI output. Leave blank if it is not available in Home Assistant.

source.title: Totalplay input on TV
source.description: Select the HDMI/input that the Totalplay decoder is connected to. It will be selected only if the TV reports a different current source.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach this IP address and port
error.no_stb_found: No Totalplay decoder responded on the detected local networks
error.not_totalplay_stb: The address is reachable, but it did not respond as a Totalplay STB

init.title: Decoder and connected television
init.description: Edit the STB model and connected hardware without removing the integration.

source.title: Totalplay input on TV
source.description: Select the HDMI/input for the Totalplay decoder. The integration will check the current source before changing it.
